panels.title: Live video & transcript
panels.description: The live page: video and transcript side by side. The highlighted line follows the video. Click any line to replay it; 'Go to' opens any time.

panels.title: Stream
panels.description: Is the channel's stream arriving right now (UDP packets decoded).

panels.title: Text delay
panels.description: Median time from the end of a spoken segment to its live text, last 2 minutes.

panels.title: Behind live
panels.description: Age of the oldest audio waiting for transcription. Near 0 = keeping up. Above asr.fast_max_lag_s (CPU: 120 s) audio is skipped and counted below.

panels.title: Model confidence
panels.description: Average word probability of the text produced in the last 2 minutes. The model's own estimate, not verified accuracy.

panels.title: Speech in audio
panels.description: Share of the last minute the voice detector heard speech (music, ads and silence lower it).

panels.title: Segments / min
panels.description: Speech segments sent for transcription in the last minute.

panels.title: Text delay (speech end → live text)
panels.description: How long after speech the live text appears (1-minute windows).

panels.title: Model confidence
panels.description: Average model confidence per pass. A drop often means music, crosstalk or English speech.

panels.title: Transcription queue (behind live)
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting job per pass. FAST should stay low; REFINE only runs when FAST is idle.

panels.title: Stream bitrate (audio)
panels.description: Incoming audio bitrate. A flat line at 0 means no packets arrive.

panels.title: Word accuracy (1 − WER)
panels.description: 1 − WER of the live (FAST) configuration against hand-made reference transcripts (read speech, FLEURS).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 1 - value FROM accuracy_results WHERE kind='bench' AND metric='wer' AND config LIKE 'large-v3-turbo int8 b1 seg10%' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Sure words that were correct
panels.description: 'Sure' = words the model rated ≥ 90% confident. Share of them that matched the reference (bench/calibration.py).

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM accuracy_results WHERE kind='calibration_word' AND metric='precision' AND threshold BETWEEN 0.899 AND 0.901 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Share of words that are 'sure'
panels.description: How many of all words the model rated ≥ 90 % confident (reference set).

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM accuracy_results WHERE kind='calibration_word' AND metric='kept_share' AND threshold BETWEEN 0.899 AND 0.901 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

options.content: **How to read this:** these numbers were measured once against hand-checked transcripts of read Urdu speech. Live TV is harder. *Confidence* above is the model's own guess, not accuracy.

panels.title: Segments
panels.description: Stored transcript segments (≈ 8–10 s of speech each) in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Avg confidence
panels.description: Average model confidence in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(confidence) FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: ≥ min confidence
panels.description: Share of stored segments at or above the Min confidence variable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN confidence >= $min_conf THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Re-checked (2nd pass)
panels.description: Share of segments whose careful second pass finished (CPU: only in pauses).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN pass='refined' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Re-check skipped
panels.description: Second pass skipped because the CPU was busy (live text kept).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(flags) f WHERE f LIKE 'refine_skipped%')

panels.title: Audio skipped
panels.description: Seconds of speech not transcribed because the machine was overloaded (asr.fast_max_lag_s). 0 = nothing skipped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum((details->>'duration_s')::float), 0) FROM stream_events WHERE $__timeFilter(at_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND type = 'fast_skipped'

panels.title: Transcript — click the text to open that moment with video
panels.description: Stored transcript segments in the selected time range (top-right picker), filtered by Channel and Min confidence (top-left). Click a row's text to open the player at that moment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_utc AS "time", channel_id, pass, round(confidence::numeric, 3) AS confidence, text_raw AS text, extract(epoch FROM start_utc) AS t FROM asr_segments WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc) AND channel_id IN (${channel:sqlstring}) AND ($min_conf = 0 OR confidence >= $min_conf) ORDER BY start_utc DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Measured accuracy (reference transcripts)
panels.description: From result files recorded with `stt record-accuracy`. accuracy = 1 − WER.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, kind, config, metric, threshold, round(value::numeric, 3) AS value, n FROM accuracy_results WHERE (kind = 'bench' AND metric IN ('wer','cer','rtf')) OR (kind LIKE 'calibration%' AND threshold IN (0, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95)) ORDER BY dataset, kind, config, metric, threshold

panels.title: speech_end → final (p50 / p95)
panels.description: How long after someone stops speaking the live (FAST) text appears. p50 = half of the sentences are faster than this; p95 = 95 % are. Rising lines = the CPU is falling behind.

panels.title: speech_end → refined (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Same, for the careful second pass (REFINE). On CPU it only runs when FAST is idle, so it can be minutes behind or empty during continuous speech.

panels.title: speech → partial (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Time from speech start to the first partial caption (only in streaming mode; empty in segment mode).

panels.title: ASR queue lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting transcription job. FAST lag growing without limit = overloaded (with asr.fast_max_lag_s set, older live audio is skipped and counted as 'Audio skipped').

panels.title: ASR queue depth
panels.description: How many transcription jobs are waiting. FAST should stay near 0–2; REFINE may grow (it is capped and older work is skipped, flagged refine_skipped).

panels.title: RTF p50 / p95
panels.description: Real-time factor: seconds of compute per second of audio. Below 1 = faster than real time.

panels.title: Stream up
panels.description: 1 when the channel's UDP stream is being received, 0 when it is down.

panels.title: Clock drift
panels.description: Difference between the stream's own clock (PTS) and the computer clock. Stays near 0; spikes at loop restarts / encoder resets are re-anchored automatically.

panels.title: VAD speech ratio
panels.description: Share of the last minute that the voice detector classified as speech (music/silence lower it).

panels.title: Stream events / min
panels.description: Stream events per minute: up/down, discontinuities (timestamp jumps), drift corrections.

panels.title: Guard drops / min, refine skipped
panels.description: Segments removed or flagged by the hallucination guards, and REFINE passes skipped under load.

panels.title: Segments emitted / min
panels.description: Speech segments sent for transcription per minute (silence = cut at a pause, forced = cut at max length inside continuous speech).

panels.title: Ingest bitrate
panels.description: Incoming audio bitrate per channel — a flat line at 0 means no packets arrive.

list.name: ui_url
list.label: Player URL
list.description: Where the live-stt web UI is reachable from your browser (e.g. http://your-server:8000).

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT id FROM channels WHERE enabled ORDER BY id
